selfEvidence.scope: Frozen author 403 finite self samples plus synchronized nested-stage clearance/domain; matching exact rig. Fixed authored bonds and shaft shoulder/socket contacts inherited in bounded authored assembly.

lifecycle: Complete trajectory returns to fixed park after supported fall; no instant reset. End park checked against down target. Cancel/seek/late/scope changes require separate audited retract or cue-only; no future old-down target retrigger.
method: Actual triangles + dual-BVH surface checks, bidirectional closed-part containment, disjoint closed convex hull cover for open parts, finite time sampling. Soft depth is sampled actual contained-vertex depth, not exact maximum. No continuous collision, performance or WebGL claim.
geometryFingerprintMethod: Production actor-snapshot.ts: Int32 micron transformed actor-local Float32 positions and original triangle indices, render order base/cap/hog/main; offline BVH hash retained separately.
